{{Quote|Defeating me won't stop the Empire. I'm just one man. The Empire is legion.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Weir/Legends|Weir]]|<ref name="XWRL 3" />}}
The '''Mission to Tralus''' took place in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] defeated [[General/Legends|General]] [[Weir/Legends|Weir]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] but failed in rescuing [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]].

==Background==
{{Quote|We've done enough damage for one day. I think the Corellians now understand that the Empire still rules this system.|General Weir|<ref name="XWRL 3" />}}
Two weeks after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], General Weir ordered a small strike against [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Weir was surprised to discover a small band of Rebels defending the Coronet citizens. Although his men were unable to eliminate [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], Weir was satisfied with the amount of destruction they caused and with the capture of [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]].

[[File:Weirtorturingten.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Weir/Legends|Weir]] torturing [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]].]]

Weir personally undertook the interrogation of Numb and quickly found a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] attached to Numb's wrist. He proceeded to torture Numb with electricity and Numb soon broke and supplied Weir with all the information he wanted, including sizes and secret locations of military forces. Weir planned to provide the information to [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]].

==The battle==
{{Quote|They won't last long against a Jedi, Sir.''"<br />"''Just delay them until we launch. The information the Sullustan revealed must be delivered to Imperial High Command.|A [[Scout trooper/Legends|Scout trooper]] and General Weir|<ref name="XWRL 3" />}}
[[File:Wedge_shoots_Weir.jpg|thumb|right|220px|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] shoots down Weir.]]
The Rebel [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] helped the pilots track down the base to [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]]. The Rogues found the secret [[Weir's base|base]] by enlisting the help of [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Leyli]], a [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] who reluctantly agreed to risk helping the Rebels upon learning of the death of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. In response, Weir ordered a full-scale evacuation of the Imperial outpost. Although aware that his soldiers could not defeat the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], he ordered his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to attack the Rebels as a stalling tactic, while Weir fled in his [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] to provide Numb's information.

[[File:Wedgepunchweir.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Wedge Antilles subduing and capturing General Weir.]]

As [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] pursued the general in stolen [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]], Weir scrambled [[Sunspot Squadron]] and led the Rogue pilots through narrow underground tunnels in an unsuccessful attempt to destroy them. Once the fighters reached the surface, Antilles shot the left wing off of Weir's interceptor, causing the starfighter to crash land on Tralus. As Celchu destroyed the remaining TIE, Antilles landed and apprehended Weir, who escaped from his ship's wreckage before it exploded but was unable to flee due to injuries.

==Aftermath==
Antilles was tempted to kill Weir in retaliation for Ten Numb, but resisted the urge because he did not want to reduce himself to the general's level. Instead, Weir was arrested and extradited to [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], where he was to be interrogated by Rebel officers.
